start.title: Empty Nets
start.text:
Dawn over the lake.
All night, and not one fish.

choices.feedback: Luke 5:2 — Simon and his partners were washing their nets after fishing all night.

curse_consequence.title: Stay
curse_consequence.text:
Anger will not feed you.
Begin again.

leave_consequence.title: Linger
leave_consequence.text:
Stay by the water.
A voice is coming.

teaching.title: A Stranger's Voice
teaching.text:
Crowds press near.
"May I teach from your boat?"

choices.feedback: Luke 5:3 — Jesus asked Simon to put out a little from the land so He could teach the multitudes from the boat.

refuse_consequence.title: Welcome Him
refuse_consequence.text:
His voice is gentle.
Give what little you have.

catch.title: Cast the Nets
catch.text:
"Cast into the deep," he says.
But the night gave nothing.

choices.feedback: Luke 5:5 — Simon answered Jesus, "Master, we have toiled all night and caught nothing; nevertheless at Your word I will let down the net."

refuse_cast_consequence.title: Trust
refuse_cast_consequence.text:
His word is not like other words.
Lower the nets.

argue_consequence.title: Obey
argue_consequence.text:
There is nothing to lose.
Do as he asks.

miracle.title: Nets Overflowing
miracle.text:
Fish surge, the nets break.
You fall to your knees.

choices.feedback: Luke 5:8 — When Simon Peter saw the great catch of fish, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, "Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, O Lord!"

boast_consequence.title: Humble Yourself
boast_consequence.text:
The miracle is not yours.
Kneel before him.

call.title: Follow Me
call.text:
"Do not be afraid.
From now, you will fish for men."

choices.feedback: Luke 5:11 — When they had brought their boats to land, they forsook all and followed Him.

hesitate_consequence.title: Step Forward
hesitate_consequence.text:
Boats and nets will pass.
His call will not.

bargain_consequence.title: Today
bargain_consequence.text:
Tomorrow is not promised.
Follow now.

follow.title: A New Road
follow.text:
Nets fall to the sand.
You walk into a new life.
